response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack development skills and a diverse technical background, but his experience with C++ and industrial automation is limited. His expertise in TypeScript, Node.js, and web technologies is extensive, but the role requires deep C++ proficiency, secure coding practices, and industrial cybersecurity knowledge, which are not prominently highlighted in his resume.
strengths: Extensive experience with full-stack development, including modern web technologies (TypeScript, Node.js, React) and cloud platforms (AWS).
Proven track record of mentoring, technical leadership, and contributions to open-source projects, demonstrating strong collaboration and knowledge-sharing skills.
Diverse project experience across embedded systems, IoT, and real-time applications, showcasing adaptability and problem-solving abilities.
concerns: Limited recent hands-on experience with C++ and STL, which are core requirements for the role.
Lack of explicit experience with industrial cybersecurity standards (e.g., IEC 62443) or Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL) practices.
Most roles emphasize web and mobile development, with minimal focus on industrial automation, networking, or multi-threaded systems.
